note: Marszałkowska from the Świętokrzyska stop line's arrows (palace.json m_south s 50) to the Sienkiewicza-Fangora crossing, where marsz_defilad starts (m_south s 170), as the city's Zielona Marszałkowska traffic plan draws it (um.warszawa.pl, 'organizacja ruchu i zieleń po przebudowie'; F 2026-11-09, IMG_7688 and the screenshot of 22:59). Northbound (east carriageway, left of the axis): two lanes out of the crossing, then the kerb flares out over 17 m (m_south s 145-162, where the OSM verge's own edge flares) into a third lane, the bus stop lane by the shelter at s 122.7 that carries on as the right turn into Świętokrzyska; main had three lanes painted from the crossing on a kerb that slid 2.5 m over 110 m, so a lane appeared from nowhere at the neck. Southbound (west carriageway): two 3.15 m lanes on a green strip with columnar elms (+3.0..+6.0, the OSM grass strip main's carriageway ran over), widening into the hatched refuge at the crossing that marsz_defilad's s 0 continues. The east tram platform (Metro Świętokrzyska, -6.3..-2.8) is kept and the carriageway's inner edge follows it. Axis: the tram midline, the same line as palace.json m_south and marsz_defilad (local s = m_south s - 50); offsets to the right of the axis (it runs south: right = west). Both ends match main's (north) and marsz_defilad's (south) cross-sections to the centimetre.
